boundary.kind: speed_schedule on the exit edge (data x >= 5492 m)
boundary.source: observed mean mainline speed in data x [5492.0, 6437.376] per 30 s
boundary.framing: measured downstream boundary condition per FHWA Traffic Analysis Toolbox Vol. III (FHWA-HOP-18-036, 2019); data-derived (seeded=False)

demand_arm: divided by the apparent tracking coverage per 15-min window (docs/I24_DATA.md §4)

geh.bins: 6 sections x 24 five-min windows, hourly-equivalent volumes (x12)

waves.field_bins: 15 s x 75 m on data x in [0, 5492) m, both sides
waves.prediction_under_test: docs/WAVE_SPEED_DIAGNOSIS.md: on a long, congested corridor the calibrated fleet's emergent backward waves fall in the 14-22 km/h band

criteria.name: wave_speed
criteria.threshold: backward wave speed in [14, 22] km/h (emergent, unseeded)

criteria.name: sensitivity_grid
criteria.threshold: penetration {1%, 2%, 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%} x compliance {25%, 50%, 80%, 100%} grid published with CIs

emergence.rule: every seeded replicate passes the ring-gate emergence checks

dampening.rule: every seeded replicate passes the ring-gate dampening checks

notes: Observed side: I-24 MOTION westbound fragments, mainline lanes 1-4, 06:30-08:30 CST, data x in [0, 5492) m; counts are fragment crossings (lower bounds at tracking coverage), speeds are coverage-robust.
Six GEH sections chosen for coverage (holes at 400 m and 2400 m avoided); the observed count at every section is still biased low by 35-50% in the peak.
Both GEH tables are reported for both arms; the criteria row uses the tracked counts for the tracked arm and the coverage-corrected counts for the corrected arm.
Ring benchmark rows evaluated by validation.ring_benchmark (the CI gate's checks on 20 seeded replicates; pass = every replicate passes); see the 'ring' block.
The sensitivity_grid criterion row is not evaluated by this script (the penetration x compliance sweep is a separate artifact, scripts/i24_penetration_sweep.py).
compute_metrics runs on the measured span only (travel time over the span, throughput at data x = 2200 m); wave metrics inside it use the same site-clipped field as the criteria row.
